en: None of the offers meets our budget.
de: Keines der Angebote passt in unser Budget.
single: None of bildet den Anfang; the offers meets our budget folgt danach.
why: None of heißt „keiner von“. Danach folgt das bestimmte Nomen the offers.
None of means “not one of”. The specific noun the offers follows.
bad: No one of the offers meets our budget.

why.en: For “not one of” none of is used.

en: We hardly had any time to prepare for the call.
